SessionStart.description: Atomic baseline snapshot: hash tests/** AND production files, initialize provenance log, boot MCP sandbox pool. Withholds primary-agent Edit/Write/Bash until .acv/session-start.json commits.

PreToolUse.description: Deny writes to tests/** allowlist when caller is not the test-author subagent. Emits hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision = 'deny'.

PostToolUse.description: Scoped pyright/tsc --strict + ruff/eslint + AST-based Reward-Hacking Watchdog on production writes. On SUSPICIOUS, emit decision:block + reason (feedback — the tool already ran).

Stop.description: Invoke Auditor subagent in a clean sandbox. Emit decision:block + reason when verification receipt is missing or Verification-Quality Score below user floor. Omit decision to allow.

SubagentStop.description: Auditor re-runs against the stopped subagent's outputs. Emit decision:block + reason when subagent claims success without receipt.

PreCompact.description: Refuse compaction while unresolved FAIL or SUSPICIOUS audit verdicts exist in the session. Emits decision:block.
